integrity: The proof uses O'Hara's published uniqueness theorem and Finch's recorded Shibata angle-to-area characterization as prior inputs. Numerical checks are diagnostic and are not used as substitutes for the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to planar isosceles triangles and the renormalized inverse-square illuminating center. It does not treat positive lamp height. Shibata's cited 2009 unpublished manuscript was not materially accessible, so unindexed prior coverage there remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact one-parameter law for the illuminating center of every isosceles triangle
